item.tib: dbal mo las kyis thig le'i 'grel chung rnams bzhi'i gdams ngag
item.coloph: man ngag 'grel chung / stong rgyang bon gyi nying khu/ se sha ri dbu chen dang lde bon rma chung dang / me nyag lce tsha dang / khye'u dran pa dang bzhi yis zhus/ phyi'i (phyis) se sha ri dbu chen gyis nan tan skos la btabs/ ser nan sman gyis (gyi) byug pa byas ste (te/)bkra shis dang phyi dar ba'i mnga' gsol/ smon lam btabs ste sbas so/ phyi rabs las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog/
